summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Transportation to issue regulations prohibiting airlines and ticket agents from excessively increasing ticket prices (defined as 30% or more) during a declared disaster or emergency, deeming such increases an unfair or deceptive practice.

scores.thoughts: The bill mandates the Secretary of Transportation to issue regulations and the FAA Administrator to conduct a study and submit a report. These activities would require some government resources, leading to a minor increase in spending.
